title_sq: Vile 3 kateshe per Shitje prane TEG!
description_sq:
Rezidenca Olive Grove ndodhet perballe kalase se Petreles, 5 minuta larg Teg dhe 15 minuta larg qendres se Tiranes. Kjo rezidence banimi ka infrastructure modern, siguri 24 ore, siperfaqe recreative (kende lojrash, hapesira te gjelberuara, fushe sporti, bar-kafe etj).
Mbi truallin me siperfaqe 179,3m² eshte projektuar vila me siperfaqe totale ndertimi 240,8m².
Vila ka 3 kate dhe organizohet ne:
Kati perdhe - 69,8m² (ambient ndenje, ambient gatimi i vecuar, verande dhe oborr te gjelberuar)
Kati i pare - 66m² (2 dhoma gjumi secila me garderobe, nje tualet dhe ballkon)
Kati i dyte - 66m² + 38,4m² verande (dhome matrimoniale, garderobe, tualet dhe verande).
Lloji i Fasades - e ventiluar.
Ne afersi te qytetit por edhe mjaftueshem larg zhurmes dhe pluhurit, kjo vile eshte vendi perfekt per te jetuar.
description_en: The Olive Grove residence is located in front of the Petrele castle, 5 minutes from Teg and 15 minutes from the center of Tirana. This residential residence has modern infrastructure, 24-hour security, recreational areas (playgrounds, green spaces, sports fields, coffee bars, etc.). A villa with a total construction area of ​​240.8m² has been designed on the plot of land with an area of ​​179.3m². The villa has 3 floors and is organized in: Ground floor - 69.8m² (living room, separate kitchen, veranda and green yard) First floor - 66m² (2 bedrooms each with wardrobe, a toilet and balcony) Second floor - 66m² + 38.4m² veranda (double bedroom, wardrobe, toilet and veranda). Facade type - ventilated. Close to the city but far enough away from noise and dust, this villa is the perfect place to live.
